name: Microsoft Copilot for Productivity by Microsoft and LinkedIn
description: Six-course professional certificate from Microsoft and LinkedIn Learning covering Microsoft 365 Copilot fundamentals, prompt engineering, and AI-powered workflows in Teams, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint. Completed all 6 courses and passed the final assessment.

criteria.narrative: Completed all six courses in the Microsoft Copilot for Productivity learning path on LinkedIn Learning: Learning Microsoft 365 Copilot for Work, Microsoft Copilot: The Art of Prompt Writing, Copilot in Teams: AI-Powered Collaboration, Copilot in Outlook: Maximize Your Workday Efficiency, Excel with Copilot: AI-Driven Data Analysis, and Copilot in PowerPoint: From Prompt to Presentation. Passed the final summative assessment to earn the certificate.
